answer: Each identity must maintain a 20-epoch signed-response trail. After commitment, a pulse beacon assigns five random public datasets; the kth account in one funding forge must answer 5k datasets, so 100 aliases owe 25,250 independent results. A marble Merkle root binds draws, outputs, and timestamps. Validators replay 12% of results; a duplicate output or missed deadline burns a 35-POA bond and resets every linked trail.
